answer: One human, one place: each identity shows a signed location proof from a distinct site, GPS and cell-tower timing checked against a beacon in 60s. The attestation is the timber of the claim, cannot float twice down the river of replays: the beacon seed changes each epoch. An ivory seal from the carrier binds tower, cell and time to the identity key; an epoch nullifier set bars one site from minting two seats. A farm needs a real device at a real site per fake: $15 plus a 20 POA bond slashed on duplicate sites, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sites. Limits: rural gaps, GPS spoofing, shared homes.
